document: Inventory of the reference fixtures the detection, OCR and build-import tests read.

field_semantics.origin: synthetic = constructed, sanitized or non-capture material; real = recorded from an actual game session
field_semantics.availability: present = every declared file exists and its sha256 matches
field_semantics.null_fields: A null language, geometry, tooltip or affix-row value means the case does not carry that information yet. It is never guessed and never back-filled from look-alike material.
field_semantics.capture_only_fields: game_ui_language, window_geometry, expected_tooltip_selection and expected_affix_rows describe capture cases. Import payload cases set them to null because they are rule-import inputs and expectations, not tooltip captures.
field_semantics.expected_affix_rows: For an import expectation this field names the fixture that defines the expected rows and the row count of its affix_preset.affixes list; the manifest never restates rows that the fixture already owns.

provenance.source: Maintainer live session 2026-10-02 (native 1920x1080, preset 1080p_SMF, mouse mode): the 375x883 tooltip crop the d4lc tooltip detection selected for an Ancestral Unique Sword whose "+12.0% Attack Speed" is a tempered affix rolled greater.

notes: Regression crop for the tempered greater affix marker (orange-rimmed star): the upstream 1080p_SMF preset alone finds four affix markers, the d4lc supplement template adds the fifth.
The crop shows the d4lc overlay dots of that session overlapping its leftmost ~9 px columns; the marker column starts at x=18 and is not affected.
The crop carries no OCR ground truth.
